answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 54 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a wander bet on surviving 54 epochs of grading, and every cipher settlement recomputes the ledge schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 24 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
